strings.sys.usage.full:
Usage:
/sys — show local slots
/sys <n> — show local slot
/sys <n> on|off|delete
/sys <n> save|replace <message>
/sys output <n>

/sys global … — manage instance-global slots
/sys g … — short alias for /sys global …
strings.sys.error.invalid_slot: Invalid slot '{slot}'. Use 1-10, /sys global, or /sys g.
strings.sys.error.empty_slot: Slot {slot} is empty — save a message first.

strings.sys.notice.saved.local: Slot {slot} saved (inactive). Use /sys {slot} on to activate.
strings.sys.notice.saved.global: Global slot {slot} saved (inactive). Use /sys global {slot} on to activate.

strings.mode.memory.enabled:
Memory+ continuity is now **ON**.
• Working mode remains **{mode}**
• Memory+ works independently in Fixed and Flex
• Use `/memory plus off` to pause it
strings.mode.retired: Wrapper, Audit, and Dual-brain working modes have been retired. HASHI now supports only Fixed and Flex; Fixed is the default when the backend supports persistent sessions.
strings.mode.fixed.requires_session:
Fixed mode requires a backend with real persistent-session support.
`{backend}` is stateless, so the current mode was kept.
Use `/mode flex`, or choose HER v2, Codex CLI, Claude CLI, or Grok CLI first.
strings.mode.fixed.switched:
Switched to **fixed** mode.
• The backend session will persist across messages
• Bridge sends incremental inputs without re-injecting history
• `/backend` is disabled; use `/mode flex` to re-enable
• `/new` will terminate the current session and start fresh
strings.mode.flex.switched:
Switched to **flex** mode.
• Full context injection per request
• `/backend` switching re-enabled
strings.mode.dual_brain.switched:
Switched to **dual-brain** mode.
• Left brain: `{left_backend}` / `{left_model}`
• Right brain: `{right_backend}` / `{right_model}`
{detail}
• Use `/brain` to configure left/right models and custom prompts
• Active `/sys` slots remain part of the right-brain runtime prompt
strings.mode.wrapper.switched:
Switched to **wrapper** mode.
• Core: `{core_backend}` / `{core_model}`
• Wrapper: `{wrapper_backend}` / `{wrapper_model}`
• Active core: {core_state}
{detail}
• Use `/core`, `/wrap`, and `/wrapper` to configure
• User-visible responses are rewritten through the wrapper model
strings.mode.audit.switched:
Switched to **audit** mode.
• Core: `{core_backend}` / `{core_model}`
• Audit: `{audit_backend}` / `{audit_model}`
• Delivery: `{delivery}`
• Threshold: `{threshold}`
{detail}
• Use `/core` and `/audit` to configure
• Core responses are delivered unchanged; audit findings follow separately
